scope: WP4c LUCiD point encoder, runbook v4 §3.5.4-§3.5.5
status: development; architecture frozen by §3.5.5, optimiser and learning-rate conventions pending the WP5 config review

data.geometry: DetectorGeometry from lucid_bombs (path-configured WCTE map, or the synthetic schema fixture in local tests)
data.pmt_id_in_mpmt: 1-based; within split = even context / odd target (9/10 per module)
data.token_source: generated run hits.npz (CSR-like sparse: event_ids, offsets, pmt_id, charge_pe, time_ns)

scaling.position: x, y / radius_m; z / half_height_m (fixed detector dimensions, no per-event normalisation)
scaling.direction: unit vector / 1.0 (dimensionless; fixed divisor recorded for completeness)
scaling.log_charge: ln(q / 1 PE) for hit PMTs, 0 for unhit PMTs
scaling.time_100ns: (first-hit time - trigger) / 100 ns for hit PMTs, 0 for unhit PMTs

architecture.kind: serialised point transformer (Hilbert sort, windowed attention)
architecture.readout: output of block 4 before any final normalisation; every loss and probe uses this
architecture.window_shift_rule: cyclic roll by 32 on alternate layers (layer index odd)
architecture.token_order: 3D Hilbert curve of the PMT positions, 12 bits per axis on the fixed detector box
architecture.mask_embedding: one learned vector (std 0.02) replacing hidden tokens after the input projection and before block 1
architecture.init: spectral muP linear init (reconstruction_model.model rule), mask embedding N(0, 0.02^2)

predictor.kind: 2 pre-norm blocks over context read-out tokens plus position queries at the target PMTs
predictor.queries: scaled position (3 features) of each target PMT; no data enters the query
predictor.output: one d_model prediction per target PMT

across.module_order: 3D Hilbert curve of module centres (10 bits per axis)
across.target: random contiguous half of the module order, cyclic, n_modules // 2 = 52 modules

views.exclusion: across: redraw up to 3 times, then exclude and count; within: exclude and count

occupancy_ablation.balanced: subsample unhit PMTs of the context view only to match its hit count; every target PMT is still queried

training.status: registered by §3.5.5; the smoke objective in point_encoder is not a registered arm
training.gradient_accumulation_note: measured unnecessary: batch 32 forward+backward peaks at about 2.4 GiB process RSS on CPU, well inside the §6.2 9.6 GB Titan cap
training.optimizer_note: repository AdamW/Muon conventions as in v3 WP4; no value is chosen in WP4c, the WP5 config review fills them before outcomes

probes.amplitude_criterion: R² >= 0.9 for sigreg_jepa and mae_mse, measured after the smoke and on the final encoders (§3.5.5); not implemented here

fixture_measurement.what: ridge probe recovering per-PMT log charge from the unmasked read-out tokens at random init
fixture_measurement.fixture: synthetic schema geometry (1995 PMTs), 8 events of 300 hits, 4 train / 4 test events, alpha 1.0, 128 read-out features

memory.cap: §6.2 per-process GPU memory: about 9.6 GB on a Titan, 21 GB on an L40S
memory.verdict: batch 32 fits the Titan cap with roughly 4x headroom; gradient accumulation not needed; GPU peak memory and throughput are pending (no GPU in this session)
memory.repeat_run_note: peak RSS is a high-water mark; a second run gave batch 32 at 2482-2844 MiB, i.e. about 2.4-2.8 GiB
